138040.notes: Re-written 14 Nov 2026 for per 2026-Q3. PRIMARY DOCUMENT NOT OPENED: meritzgroup.com returned robots_disallowed for the transcript PDFs and the site root was blocked; no KIND/DART URL of the 11 Nov filing surfaced in search. So primary:false on both. Quarter figures come from Digital Today's automated reproduction of the exchange filing '연결재무제표기준영업(잠정)실적(공정공시)' of 11 Nov 2026 (million won): net income Q3 490,468 vs 668,390; owners' 470,717 vs 654,695 (-28.1%); 9M net income 1,962,069 vs 2,026,791; owners' 1,912,750 vs 1,989,645 (-3.9%). 9M EPS 11,491 (+3.5%) from The Value News and Korea Financial Times (both 11 Nov); prev_val 11,102 = 11,491/1.035 and matches the 3Q25 figure in the previous record. Metric mix: ytd is EPS, quarter is owners' net profit because Q3 standalone EPS was not published (derived 11,491 - 8,589 = 2,902 vs about 3,710 derived = about -21.8%, my arithmetic on a derived base, NOT used). Either way the lowest is negative, so real growth floors at zero. Cause of the Q3 fall: Meritz Fire investment profit 39.4 billion vs 325.0 billion (-87.9%), from valuation losses on domestic equities (company CRO: about 70 billion short-term loss on equity assets per CEOScore/BizWatch; a Shinhan analyst cited about 140 billion valuation and disposal losses, analyst figure, not used) and real estate provisions; group provisions and reserves 410.6 billion in Q3 (Bloter, S-Journal; includes reserve appropriations that do not pass through profit). Not excluded: investment results are part of the ordinary business and the company gave no after-tax amount. No profit guidance from the company (management said subsidiaries set rolling three-year plans; no figure). No permanent cause: insurance profit +34.9% in Q3, +7.6% in 9M; Securities +12.0%, Capital +23.6% in 9M. Dividend null: no cash dividend; FY2025 dividend cell is '-' in the company's 2025 status disclosure (read this session, primary), return is via buyback and cancellation.
